description: Korean dismissal notice pay (해고예고수당, 근로기준법 제26조): without 30 days' notice the employer owes 30 days of ordinary wage (the Ministry of Employment and Labor treats any shorter notice as owing the full 30 days). Exceptions: under 3 months of service, natural disaster making the business impossible, intentional serious damage listed in the enforcement rule. Applies to workplaces of any size; written notice (제27조) and unfair-dismissal remedy within 3 months (제28조) only for 5+ employees. Daily ordinary wage = monthly ordinary wage ÷ monthly paid hours (40 h/week = 209) × daily hours.

exception.description: 제26조 exception claimed by the employer

fivePlus.description: Workplace normally employs 5 or more people

monthlyOrdinaryWage.description: Monthly ordinary wage (기본급 + fixed monthly allowances) (KRW)

noticeDays.description: Days of notice before the dismissal date (0 = same day)
